entries.title: Route label retains trailing separator
entries.root_cause: The route label formatter appends a separator after the final segment. Remove the trailing separator from the formatter.

entries.title: Route label uses wrong case
entries.root_cause: The route label formatter uppercases segment names when it should preserve their case. Remove the uppercase conversion.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A nearby string assertion in the same formatter fails, but the case conversion needs a different correction from the trailing separator.

entries.title: Route fixture directory unset
entries.root_cause: The fixture loader requires KESTREL_ROUTE_FIXTURES but the job does not set it. Configure that variable to point to the fixture directory.
